summary.text: Karen Mathiak, a Republican, has represented Georgia House District 82 since being sworn in on January 9, 2017, and chairs the House State Planning and Community Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Her official biography describes Mathiak as a licensed chiropractor who has practiced in Griffin for over 30 years.
The biography says she chaired the Spalding County Zoning Board and the Spalding County Republican Party and has served on the Georgia Board of Chiropractic Examiners.
